_comment: Every factory building the company can own, in unlock order. Each has its own stations file (the production line, machine costs and floor layout) and upgrades file. A factory with no 'unlock' block is owned from the start. Unlock requirement types: 'all_automated' {factory} and 'earned' {factory, amount}. To add a factory: add an entry here, write its two JSON files and its sprites.

factories.name: Copper Cylinder Works
factories.description: Where it all began: a small line turning copper sheet into classic hot water cylinders.

factories.name: Stainless Steel Plant
factories.description: A modern plant building unvented stainless steel cylinders. Eight stages, costly to equip, and far more valuable per cylinder.
